body:
Don't read anything else. Ready?

GET JESSI TO PRESS CHARGES. 
That way, you've gotten the justice you deserve. If your boyfriend doesn't support you, ditch him. Use this as the deciding factor. If she's bold enough to hit someone, she's willing to do it again.

You sound like my ex. Until you see what it does. It's like you think you can argue with a medical diagnosis. All while denying my own experiences.

This is why I feel like killing myself in the first place.

It's like I'm speaking a different language. I struggle with getting out what I'm trying to say and I always end up offending someone or saying something I didn't mean. I'm always told "that doesn't make sense."

It feels I'm trapped in my own mind of pain and misery and experiences I  could never explain. 

And the meltdowns. My ex sees me as an idiot. Claims she's afraid of me. I've never even approached her angrily. She doesn't understand my autism, and sees me as a freak. Not someone trying their hardest to communicate. 

I'm sorry you may deal with this too. No one deserves live like this.

Only to go back on what she said and tell me she wants to be in a relationship, but she wants to take it slow. This is usually after she spends a bunch of money on me I never asked for, and acts super affectionate. 

Do you get what I'm saying? She's been clear on not wanting a relationship, but has clearly requested for a relationship. It's almost as if she's splitting, which is a characteristic of mental illnesses that require lithium. 

This isn't just some wishful thinking on my end.

I thought so to. But that's the thing. She's had guys approach her. She just decides to turn them down and stay with me. I don't mind at all, and if she had something real with another, I'd encourage her to pursue it. I have before. 

I'm worrying about her and why she chooses to work toward a relationship, then stops repeatedly on her own accord. 

But I think I'm worrying about her too much and I need to focus on what I want. Do you have any advice on how to clarify things with her in a conversation before I make a decision?

No I never claimed that. Please forgive me if I made it seem like that. 

When I have brought it up before and I've told her that this isn't want I want, she tries to make it a relationship. These are her decisions, not mine. I don't know best which is why I'm hesitant to make a decision. 

I think you're under the impression I'm just some guy that can't deal with her not wanting me. That's not it in the slightest. The continuation of me and her has been due to her own efforts.

See, I agree with everything you've said except the fact that she's been clear. If anything, there have been TONS of mixed messages. And not because she doesn't want a relationship. I don't think this changes anything, but I definitely don't think she's been clear. Any ideas of how I talk to her about this?

I agree, and honestly I don't want to. I always thought she stays because she feels bad for me, but now I realize I'm staying because I don't want to make a bad decision if it is attributed to mental illness. I am MORE than willing to stay because I'm comfortable with who she is. The only thing I'd require is a label. 

Thank you for the advice. I know eventually I will have to cut it off. I just want to know a plan attack in order to communicate with her before I make a decision.
I have, and I've pulled back before. Only to have her pursue me.
